PC: Performs primary survey, obtains all vital signs
Performs RSI using appropriate drugs/dosing, tube sizing and depth Appropriate medication and dose to control seizures
Administers appropriate medications for brady PEA arrest (if applicable) Considers appropriate differential diagnosis for altered mental status/seizure/resp failure.
MK: Obtains and accurately interprets head CT
SBP: Consults neurosurgery and appropriately dispositions patient
ICS: Obtains info from available sources (patient, medics, family, police). Organizes team/assigns duties to specific members of the team.
Provides clear instructions to team throughout resuscitation.
PROF: Appears confident and calm & asks for help if needed.
